cands.name: Mack Bernard
cands.bio: Democratic state senator for District 24 since Nov 2024. Born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti in 1976; lawyer and business executive from Boynton Beach. Florida House 2009-2012 and Palm Beach County Commission 2016-2024.
cands.local_ties: Moved to Florida in 1986; based in Boynton Beach per Wikipedia.

record.text: Palm Beach County Commission District 7 (2016-2024); won the 2024 special election for Senate District 24 unopposed in a seat swap with Bobby Powell.
Lost a 2012 Senate Democratic primary to Jeff Clemens by 17 votes after a recount; a judge rejected his suit to count 40 absentee ballots.

endorsements.text: The Palm Beach Post editorial board endorsed Bernard (Oct 13, 2026).

cands.gaps: No current donor reporting or social links collected. Owner-source search not run (web search quota exhausted).

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
